definitionZh: -moz-box-pack和-webkit-box-pack CSS 属性指定一个-moz-box或-webkit-box如何按其布局方向包装其内容. 只有在框内有额外空间时,才会看到这个效果.
sourceDefinition: The -moz-box-pack and -webkit-box-pack CSS properties specify how a -moz-box or -webkit-box packs its contents in the direction of its layout. The effect of this is only visible if there is extra space in the box.
